# The course companion

*Sixteen modules, five tracks, one rule: every abstraction is preceded by the thing it abstracts.*

The course lives in the repository, under [`modules/`](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/tree/main/modules/): slides, notebooks, exercises, workbooks and solutions, reviewed and versioned. These pages are the companion: one page per module with its reading order, the [tutorial](https://akash-coded.github.io/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/learn/) lesson that frames it, the [playbook](https://akash-coded.github.io/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/simulator/) tool that exercises the same decision, and where its errors and questions are collected. Read the module README first, always; this page tells you what to read around it.

**Where to start:** [START-HERE](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/START-HERE.md) in the repository picks a path for you. Not sure? [Module 00](Module-00-Agentic-Foundations) needs no AWS account and no code.

## The five tracks

| Track | Modules |
| --- | --- |
| **Think** | 00–01 |
| **Invoke** | 02–04 |
| **Build** | 05–09 |
| **Ground** | 10 |
| **Ship** | 11–14 |
| **Product · parallel** | 15 |

You write the agent loop by hand before meeting a framework (05 → 06), build retrieval by hand before a managed knowledge base (10), and test before you deploy (13 → 14).

## Pick a path

Nobody needs all sixteen in the same order. Each path is a subset, in a sequence, with a finish line:

| Path | For | Time | Finish line |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🚀 **[Weekend Sprint](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/learning-paths/weekend-sprint.md)** | "Show me it works, this weekend" | ~12 h | A working Bedrock agent with tools |
| 🛠️ **[Agent Engineer](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/learning-paths/agent-engineer.md)** | Building and shipping agents | ~70 h | A deployed, evaluated, gated agent |
| 🏛️ **[Solutions Architect](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/learning-paths/solutions-architect.md)** | Designing and reviewing agent systems | ~45 h | A defensible architecture with a cost model |
| 📋 **[Product Manager](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/learning-paths/product-manager.md)** | Deciding what to build and defending it | ~25 h | A PRD and a gate review you can run |
| 🔬 **[RAG Specialist](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/learning-paths/rag-specialist.md)** | Retrieval quality as the job | ~35 h | A measured, gated RAG pipeline |

1. **Attempt exercises closed-book.** Solutions are written to be read *after* you have a wrong answer to
   compare against. Reading them first converts an hour of learning into five minutes of nodding.
2. **Fill in the workbooks.** The `.xlsx` activities are where a decision gets written down and costed.
   Skipping them is how you end up unable to defend the design later.
3. **Do not skip Module 05.** Writing the agent loop by hand is what stops every later framework from
   being magic.
4. **Watch the bill.** Set a budget alarm before Module 02. See [cost controls](https://github.com/akash-coded/aws-bedrock-agentcore-strands/blob/main/docs/setup/cost-controls.md).
